VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims all 47 tests pass and describes the fix in detail, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 47 tests pass," which demands objective verification, not self-attestation. Without attached test results, diffs, or CI artifacts, there is no way to independently confirm the fix was actually implemented or that the test suite actually passes.
